name: QR Codes
description: QR code generation: any text becomes a scannable PNG. Written in C against the open part ABI.

operations.name: qr.encode
operations.description: Encodes text as a QR code PNG. Returns {base64, size, modules}.

inputs.name: text
inputs.description: The text or URL to encode (up to a few hundred characters)

outputs.name: base64
outputs.description: PNG bytes, base64; bind an image element's src to it

operations.howto: Route "base64" into state and bind an image element's src from that key; the runtime renders it directly. Build the payload with a format transform, e.g. a wifi card is qr.encode on text formatted as WIFI:T:WPA;S:{{value}};P:<password>;; from the ssid input, and a link QR encodes the url input as-is. Chain file.save with the same base64 to export the PNG.
